Mine?

  • 1 pound lean 92% or higher ground beef
  • Tablespoon or more of garlic powder
  • Tablespoon of seasoned salt
  • a few shakes of smoked paprika
  • crumbled bleu cheese, just enough to not spoil the patty integrity

Mix it well.

Form patties, about the size of your palm, about a half inch, or more, thick.

Let rest by covering with saran wrap. Do not refrigerate again. Get your grill going hot.

Grab some kaiser rolls. Some sweet lettuce. Gouda cheese slices. Beefsteak tomato. Red or white onion. Portabello mushroom (sliced strips or small sliced caps) Real mayo.

Cook the burgers one each side, flipping once. You want some decent char or browning. I like mine medium rare. Melt gouda slices over burgers on grill. Take off and let rest about a minute.

Combine ingredients. I suggest mayo with mushrooms and lettuce. Cheese on bottom with onions and tomatoes.

Enjoy.
